R20 fixture standingAnswersHeldBack takes the member it is asked for: carol's own question's entry

R21 a standing question reads only the asking scope's reads: no capture request, no fetch, no outside read, and no AI run but R19's
R23 its tables are declared with their classes: the counts admin-only; standing questions and their runs seen by their owner alone, export never
R24 its rows are held in its own table with their translations: the four checks, ANSWER_MALFORMED, the rule services' and the standing questions' refusals
R25 no place is named in its behaviour or outward text
R26 a standing question runs for a member no account serves as for any member: set, run, seen and ended with no account; new finds reach them once as a list, answer null, no model called

R29 every row's translation names the group's Civicsmith as "your group's Civicsmith" or not at all, never copy, instance, plane or server; C-135.6 and C-135.8 as the sweep words them
R29 the refusals' details and the not-held reasons it answers: the rule services switched off (index.mjs:202), no profile active for profiles (rules.mjs:60) and for deadlinecompute (rules.mjs:83)
R3 an answer of any other shape is refused ANSWER_MALFORMED naming the field, and nothing is shown

R30 a standing question's AI half asks accountFor with kind standing and no project, and keep-away for the standing use
R30 an ask calls accountFor with kind ask and its project, and is judged by useCheck for the account chosen in place of the ceiling: {ok, account, owner}, or the refusal unchanged; writes nothing
R30 fixture limitsUnreadable is the real refusal of an ask whose paying limits cannot be judged: LIMITS_UNREADABLE, nothing used
R30 R19 a standing run's grant reads under its own use: a project kept away from standing questions is dropped from what the AI half reads

R30 R2 widened: every read under a grant also drops the rows of projects kept away from AI for the grant's use (ai-accounts.projectsKeptAway), before the read log records them, and a count counts none; another use's limit drops nothing; unreadable limits, or ai-accounts unreachable, drop every project's rows
R30 with no useCheck handed in, answers judges by ai-use's useCheck on its own host (the negative control: an account under its limits is served)

R31 a baseline's own value is labelled by its basis: the member's account, or the quote of the document it rests on; any other figure in it must be sourced (R4)
R32 a cause is stated only quoting what was read that establishes it (a concluded finding, or a body's own words shown as theirs), else withheld ANSWER_CAUSE_UNESTABLISHED: cause not established

R32 the closed list (K2472), frozen and tested whole: each verdict, likelihood or rating word in Civicsmith's own words is withheld ANSWER_VERDICT_WORD; inside a quotation of what was read it stands; grade and strength are not on it

R33 checkSentences exports R4's checks over sentences that each name what they cite: the same judgement as checkAnswer's, given a read log or, offline, the objects that were read; ANSWER_MALFORMED for any other shape; pure; never throws
R34 from the change, R16's ending by date and R17's due read the new end: an end moved later keeps it running past the old date, one moved earlier ends it on passing the new date
R34 op=standingendset: the author is the control plane's viewer stamp, the id from the query or the body, the end from the body

R34 R27 the listeners are told once, after the act's transaction, with the next due day: at once on the author's own act; inside another module's act (following R25's keep) only once that commits, never when it rolls back; a refusal and an unchanged end tell no one

R34 refusals in order, each writing nothing: a machine or empty author MACHINE_CANNOT_AUTHOR; a question not the author's, an administrator's ask included, answered as an absent one NO_SUCH_STANDING_QUESTION; an ended one STANDING_ENDED, by its author or its date; an end not a calendar day after today STANDING_NEEDS_END

R34 the author changes the end: {ok, id, ends, was}; an equal end answers unchanged and writes nothing; each earlier end stays readable on the question, with who and when, to its author alone; no model, no account

R36 answers declares standingquestionend: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R36 answers declares standingquestionset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused

R36 R7 the owners' declarations, found from build/modules.json, hold ruleservicesstate as answers' own, declared by no other owner
R4 a summary resting on a withheld sentence is withheld; when nothing remains the answer states what could not be established; it never throws
R4 ANSWER_ABSENCE_WITHOUT_LEVEL: an absence names its level, and states it only in the five absence terms
R4 ANSWER_CITES_UNREAD: a holding the log did not answer, or a quote not byte-exact in what it answered, is withheld; the others stand

R6 a rule item names its label; a legal_information item carries its quote; one without either is ANSWER_MALFORMED
R7 fixture ruleServicesState is the real read of the rule services' switch: off on a fresh team, on after the administrator's switch

R7 ruleservicesstate answers {ok: true, on} to any signed-in member: off on a fresh record (K1505 (14)), on after the administrator's switch, off again when switched off; writes nothing
R7 the rule services are built switched off (K1505 (14)): while off every service refuses RULE_SERVICES_OFF; only an administrator switches them

outside.waitsOn: calculations: the item in its interface files
tests: R3 an answer of any other shape is refused ANSWER_MALFORMED naming the field, and nothing is shown
R6 a rule item names its label; a legal_information item carries its quote; one without either is ANSWER_MALFORMED
R4 ANSWER_CITES_UNREAD: a holding the log did not answer, or a quote not byte-exact in what it answered, is withheld; the others stand
R4 ANSWER_FIGURE_UNSOURCED: a figure outside a quote must equal a figure of a CALC- result or money fact the log answered and the sentence cites
R4 R22 ANSWER_RULE_NOT_PLANE: a rule item or rule sentence not among the rule services' answers in the log is withheld; no rule reaches a member but through R7
R4 ANSWER_ABSENCE_WITHOUT_LEVEL: an absence names its level, and states it only in the five absence terms
R4 a summary resting on a withheld sentence is withheld; when nothing remains the answer states what could not be established; it never throws
R5 closed book: where the read log holds nothing, every sentence but an absence at its level is withheld, and the absence stands with its next act

R3 an answer of any other shape is refused ANSWER_MALFORMED naming the field, and nothing is shown
R6 a rule item names its label; a legal_information item carries its quote; one without either is ANSWER_MALFORMED

R36 answers declares standingquestionset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R36 answers declares standingquestionend: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R36 R7 answers declares ruleservicesstate: a read for admin and member with no fields, its requires alone raise no refusal and a field outside accepts is dropped
R36 R7 the owners' declarations, found from build/modules.json, hold ruleservicesstate as answers' own, declared by no other owner

R34 refusals in order, each writing nothing: a machine or empty author MACHINE_CANNOT_AUTHOR; a question not the author's, an administrator's ask included, answered as an absent one NO_SUCH_STANDING_QUESTION; an ended one STANDING_ENDED, by its author or its date; an end not a calendar day after today STANDING_NEEDS_END

R34 the author changes the end: {ok, id, ends, was}; an equal end answers unchanged and writes nothing; each earlier end stays readable on the question, with who and when, to its author alone; no model, no account
R34 from the change, R16's ending by date and R17's due read the new end: an end moved later keeps it running past the old date, one moved earlier ends it on passing the new date

R34 R27 the listeners are told once, after the act's transaction, with the next due day: at once on the author's own act; inside another module's act (following R25's keep) only once that commits, never when it rolls back; a refusal and an unchanged end tell no one
R34 op=standingendset: the author is the control plane's viewer stamp, the id from the query or the body, the end from the body
R30 fixture limitsUnreadable is the real refusal of an ask whose paying limits cannot be judged: LIMITS_UNREADABLE, nothing used
R16 R34 fixture standingQuestions holds the real refusals of the end acts: another's question as absent, an ended one STANDING_ENDED

R19 R20 fixture standingAnswersHeldBack is the real standingAnswersFor answer for a member's question whose find was held back by the copy's AI switch: the find told once, no answer, held_back switch_off
R20 fixture standingAnswersHeldBack takes the member it is asked for: carol's own question's entry
R7 fixture ruleServicesState is the real read of the rule services' switch: off on a fresh team, on after the administrator's switch
R7 ruleAnswer answers {ok, service, value, basis, grade, status, label, as_of} or {ok, not_held: {level, reason, act}}; recorded in the grant's read log; non-mutating; never throws
R7 the rule services are built switched off (K1505 (14)): while off every service refuses RULE_SERVICES_OFF; only an administrator switches them

R8 law: a held standard with its captured text, version and portion (legal_information, its limits); in force at a date; a profile fact with citation and status, a venue's standard of proof included; an unsourced rule is not held

R9 time: a due date from the profile rule over the start event's date, by civil-time; an uncertain date answers both candidates, the group's own deadline the earliest and a body overdue only after the latest
R10 organisations and people answer as their owners answer, with grade and basis; a holder is never inferred from a line its owner does not hold
R11 figures: evaluate runs a recipe through calculations without persisting it, its result with its denominator, computed_fact; a compare is never worded as a breach
R12 registerRuleService takes a later module's service once per name; a name held or built in is refused RULE_SERVICE_EXISTS and the first stays; it answers through R7
R7 ruleservicesstate answers {ok: true, on} to any signed-in member: off on a fresh record (K1505 (14)), on after the administrator's switch, off again when switched off; writes nothing
R1 ASK_SCOPE is one closed list, each entry naming its op, its owner and the ruling that admitted it; askAdmits answers it, pure
R1 the copy test: ASK_SCOPE equals credentials' AI_GRANT_OPS both ways, `rule` included (N580; K1603, K1609)
R2 a read under a grant never answers, names or counts a member's tie, the source-to-person link, or a hidden project's row
R31 a baseline sentence carries {baselines: [{value, rests_on, basis_kind, looked}], difference}; a baseline without its basis, or in any other shape, is ANSWER_MALFORMED naming the field
R31 a baseline's own value is labelled by its basis: the member's account, or the quote of the document it rests on; any other figure in it must be sourced (R4)

R32 the closed list (K2472), frozen and tested whole: each verdict, likelihood or rating word in Civicsmith's own words is withheld ANSWER_VERDICT_WORD; inside a quotation of what was read it stands; grade and strength are not on it
R32 a cause is stated only quoting what was read that establishes it (a concluded finding, or a body's own words shown as theirs), else withheld ANSWER_CAUSE_UNESTABLISHED: cause not established

R33 checkSentences exports R4's checks over sentences that each name what they cite: the same judgement as checkAnswer's, given a read log or, offline, the objects that were read; ANSWER_MALFORMED for any other shape; pure; never throws
R15 a member's standing question by their own act: the question, the saved query, a cadence and an end date; each refusal writes nothing

R16 a standing question, its runs and finds are its author's alone; any other viewer, an administrator included, is answered as for none; the author ends it; past its end it ends itself and runs no more

R17 due at its cadence from its last run (local day); the tick re-runs each due question's saved query under its author's sight now, no model call, at most 50, oldest due first, and records the result's ids

R18 a run finds something new when its result holds an id the previous run's did not, or an occurrence it reads changed state; a first run finds nothing; a run with nothing new records only that it ran

R19 R30 the AI half answers new finds only when the copy's switch, keep-away, an account serving the author's standing act (their own or the group's key, its standing use on) and that account's limits (ai-use.useCheck, kind standing, no project) all allow; then read-only under the grant credentials mints for the standing question, its answer passing R4; otherwise no model call and what held it back is named
R30 a standing question's AI half asks accountFor with kind standing and no project, and keep-away for the standing use

R19 keep-away (ai-accounts R7's aiKeptAway, never credentials', read after the copy's switch and before any account): kept_away with the refusal's code and translation only; no account read, no grant minted, no limit asked, no model called; the finds still told once; an unreadable setting the same; keep-away off answers as before

R19 keep-away is never reported as no_account, nor an account's refusal as kept_away: keep-away turned on between the read and accountFor or R32 is kept_away; accountFor's own refusals stay no_account; a use switched off is switch_off naming the account; an ai-accounts that cannot answer keep-away is kept away, fail closed, with KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE's row (ai-accounts R34)

R19 the sign-in arm (N796, Bob K2425; credentials R32; ai-accounts R7, R14, R19): an author served by their own held Claude sign-in with its standing use off is held back {switch_off, member}, never no_account or kept_away, no grant, no model; with it on, the grant is minted for the sign-in and the AI half runs as for the author's reference, its limits read as for any account

R20 standingAnswersFor answers a member's own new-find runs, once each, in run order after `after`, at most 200, with a cursor, labelled machine work from the standing question; nothing of another member's
R21 a standing question reads only the asking scope's reads: no capture request, no fetch, no outside read, and no AI run but R19's
R26 a standing question runs for a member no account serves as for any member: set, run, seen and ended with no account; new finds reach them once as a list, answer null, no model called

R27 onStandingSet: one listener per module, refused through membership.listenerRefusal; told {question, due} once after a question is set (its next due day) or ended by its author (null); a throwing listener never undoes the act; the notice writes nothing
R15 the saved query is checked with retrieval's relations (its R72) and zone (its R69), so a question is checked and run on one boundary (N584); a member's own search form is taken as the assistant's
R13 counts per local day and mode: asks answered, refused by code, sentences withheld by code; no member, viewer, question, address or text; read by an administrator only
R14 an ask writes no row but the counts: every table holds the same rows after an ask, except R13's
R23 its tables are declared with their classes: the counts admin-only; standing questions and their runs seen by their owner alone, export never
R24 its rows are held in its own table with their translations: the four checks, ANSWER_MALFORMED, the rule services' and the standing questions' refusals
R25 no place is named in its behaviour or outward text
the ops map routes each op to its service with the control plane's stamps from the query, never the body's
R29 every row's translation names the group's Civicsmith as "your group's Civicsmith" or not at all, never copy, instance, plane or server; C-135.6 and C-135.8 as the sweep words them
R29 the refusals' details and the not-held reasons it answers: the rule services switched off (index.mjs:202), no profile active for profiles (rules.mjs:60) and for deadlinecompute (rules.mjs:83)

R5 closed book: where the read log holds nothing, every sentence but an absence at its level is withheld, and the absence stands with its next act
R36 answers declares ruleanswer: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R36 answers declares standingquestionset: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R36 answers declares standingquestionend: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R36 R7 answers declares ruleservicesstate: a read for admin and member with no fields, its requires alone raise no refusal and a field outside accepts is dropped
R36 R7 the owners' declarations, found from build/modules.json, hold ruleservicesstate as answers' own, declared by no other owner

R34 refusals in order, each writing nothing: a machine or empty author MACHINE_CANNOT_AUTHOR; a question not the author's, an administrator's ask included, answered as an absent one NO_SUCH_STANDING_QUESTION; an ended one STANDING_ENDED, by its author or its date; an end not a calendar day after today STANDING_NEEDS_END

R34 the author changes the end: {ok, id, ends, was}; an equal end answers unchanged and writes nothing; each earlier end stays readable on the question, with who and when, to its author alone; no model, no account
R34 from the change, R16's ending by date and R17's due read the new end: an end moved later keeps it running past the old date, one moved earlier ends it on passing the new date

R34 R27 the listeners are told once, after the act's transaction, with the next due day: at once on the author's own act; inside another module's act (following R25's keep) only once that commits, never when it rolls back; a refusal and an unchanged end tell no one
R34 op=standingendset: the author is the control plane's viewer stamp, the id from the query or the body, the end from the body
R30 fixture limitsUnreadable is the real refusal of an ask whose paying limits cannot be judged: LIMITS_UNREADABLE, nothing used
R16 R34 fixture standingQuestions holds the real refusals of the end acts: another's question as absent, an ended one STANDING_ENDED

R19 R20 fixture standingAnswersHeldBack is the real standingAnswersFor answer for a member's question whose find was held back by the copy's AI switch: the find told once, no answer, held_back switch_off
R20 fixture standingAnswersHeldBack takes the member it is asked for: carol's own question's entry
R7 fixture ruleServicesState is the real read of the rule services' switch: off on a fresh team, on after the administrator's switch
R7 ruleAnswer answers {ok, service, value, basis, grade, status, label, as_of} or {ok, not_held: {level, reason, act}}; recorded in the grant's read log; non-mutating; never throws
R7 the rule services are built switched off (K1505 (14)): while off every service refuses RULE_SERVICES_OFF; only an administrator switches them

R8 law: a held standard with its captured text, version and portion (legal_information, its limits); in force at a date; a profile fact with citation and status, a venue's standard of proof included; an unsourced rule is not held

R9 time: a due date from the profile rule over the start event's date, by civil-time; an uncertain date answers both candidates, the group's own deadline the earliest and a body overdue only after the latest
R10 organisations and people answer as their owners answer, with grade and basis; a holder is never inferred from a line its owner does not hold
R11 figures: evaluate runs a recipe through calculations without persisting it, its result with its denominator, computed_fact; a compare is never worded as a breach
R12 registerRuleService takes a later module's service once per name; a name held or built in is refused RULE_SERVICE_EXISTS and the first stays; it answers through R7
R7 ruleservicesstate answers {ok: true, on} to any signed-in member: off on a fresh record (K1505 (14)), on after the administrator's switch, off again when switched off; writes nothing
R1 ASK_SCOPE is one closed list, each entry naming its op, its owner and the ruling that admitted it; askAdmits answers it, pure
R1 the copy test: ASK_SCOPE equals credentials' AI_GRANT_OPS both ways, `rule` included (N580; K1603, K1609)
R2 a read under a grant never answers, names or counts a member's tie, the source-to-person link, or a hidden project's row
R31 a baseline sentence carries {baselines: [{value, rests_on, basis_kind, looked}], difference}; a baseline without its basis, or in any other shape, is ANSWER_MALFORMED naming the field
R31 a baseline's own value is labelled by its basis: the member's account, or the quote of the document it rests on; any other figure in it must be sourced (R4)

R32 the closed list (K2472), frozen and tested whole: each verdict, likelihood or rating word in Civicsmith's own words is withheld ANSWER_VERDICT_WORD; inside a quotation of what was read it stands; grade and strength are not on it
R32 a cause is stated only quoting what was read that establishes it (a concluded finding, or a body's own words shown as theirs), else withheld ANSWER_CAUSE_UNESTABLISHED: cause not established

R33 checkSentences exports R4's checks over sentences that each name what they cite: the same judgement as checkAnswer's, given a read log or, offline, the objects that were read; ANSWER_MALFORMED for any other shape; pure; never throws
R15 a member's standing question by their own act: the question, the saved query, a cadence and an end date; each refusal writes nothing

R16 a standing question, its runs and finds are its author's alone; any other viewer, an administrator included, is answered as for none; the author ends it; past its end it ends itself and runs no more

R17 due at its cadence from its last run (local day); the tick re-runs each due question's saved query under its author's sight now, no model call, at most 50, oldest due first, and records the result's ids

R18 a run finds something new when its result holds an id the previous run's did not, or an occurrence it reads changed state; a first run finds nothing; a run with nothing new records only that it ran

R19 R30 the AI half answers new finds only when the copy's switch, keep-away, an account serving the author's standing act (their own or the group's key, its standing use on) and that account's limits (ai-use.useCheck, kind standing, no project) all allow; then read-only under the grant credentials mints for the standing question, its answer passing R4; otherwise no model call and what held it back is named
R30 a standing question's AI half asks accountFor with kind standing and no project, and keep-away for the standing use

R19 keep-away (ai-accounts R7's aiKeptAway, never credentials', read after the copy's switch and before any account): kept_away with the refusal's code and translation only; no account read, no grant minted, no limit asked, no model called; the finds still told once; an unreadable setting the same; keep-away off answers as before

R19 keep-away is never reported as no_account, nor an account's refusal as kept_away: keep-away turned on between the read and accountFor or R32 is kept_away; accountFor's own refusals stay no_account; a use switched off is switch_off naming the account; an ai-accounts that cannot answer keep-away is kept away, fail closed, with KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE's row (ai-accounts R34)

R19 the sign-in arm (N796, Bob K2425; credentials R32; ai-accounts R7, R14, R19): an author served by their own held Claude sign-in with its standing use off is held back {switch_off, member}, never no_account or kept_away, no grant, no model; with it on, the grant is minted for the sign-in and the AI half runs as for the author's reference, its limits read as for any account

R20 standingAnswersFor answers a member's own new-find runs, once each, in run order after `after`, at most 200, with a cursor, labelled machine work from the standing question; nothing of another member's
R21 a standing question reads only the asking scope's reads: no capture request, no fetch, no outside read, and no AI run but R19's
R26 a standing question runs for a member no account serves as for any member: set, run, seen and ended with no account; new finds reach them once as a list, answer null, no model called

R27 onStandingSet: one listener per module, refused through membership.listenerRefusal; told {question, due} once after a question is set (its next due day) or ended by its author (null); a throwing listener never undoes the act; the notice writes nothing
R15 the saved query is checked with retrieval's relations (its R72) and zone (its R69), so a question is checked and run on one boundary (N584); a member's own search form is taken as the assistant's
R13 counts per local day and mode: asks answered, refused by code, sentences withheld by code; no member, viewer, question, address or text; read by an administrator only
R14 an ask writes no row but the counts: every table holds the same rows after an ask, except R13's
R23 its tables are declared with their classes: the counts admin-only; standing questions and their runs seen by their owner alone, export never
R24 its rows are held in its own table with their translations: the four checks, ANSWER_MALFORMED, the rule services' and the standing questions' refusals
R25 no place is named in its behaviour or outward text
the ops map routes each op to its service with the control plane's stamps from the query, never the body's
R29 every row's translation names the group's Civicsmith as "your group's Civicsmith" or not at all, never copy, instance, plane or server; C-135.6 and C-135.8 as the sweep words them
R29 the refusals' details and the not-held reasons it answers: the rule services switched off (index.mjs:202), no profile active for profiles (rules.mjs:60) and for deadlinecompute (rules.mjs:83)

tests: R15 a member's standing question by their own act: the question, the saved query, a cadence and an end date; each refusal writes nothing

R16 a standing question, its runs and finds are its author's alone; any other viewer, an administrator included, is answered as for none; the author ends it; past its end it ends itself and runs no more

R17 due at its cadence from its last run (local day); the tick re-runs each due question's saved query under its author's sight now, no model call, at most 50, oldest due first, and records the result's ids

R18 a run finds something new when its result holds an id the previous run's did not, or an occurrence it reads changed state; a first run finds nothing; a run with nothing new records only that it ran

R19 R30 the AI half answers new finds only when the copy's switch, keep-away, an account serving the author's standing act (their own or the group's key, its standing use on) and that account's limits (ai-use.useCheck, kind standing, no project) all allow; then read-only under the grant credentials mints for the standing question, its answer passing R4; otherwise no model call and what held it back is named
R30 a standing question's AI half asks accountFor with kind standing and no project, and keep-away for the standing use

R19 keep-away (ai-accounts R7's aiKeptAway, never credentials', read after the copy's switch and before any account): kept_away with the refusal's code and translation only; no account read, no grant minted, no limit asked, no model called; the finds still told once; an unreadable setting the same; keep-away off answers as before

R19 keep-away is never reported as no_account, nor an account's refusal as kept_away: keep-away turned on between the read and accountFor or R32 is kept_away; accountFor's own refusals stay no_account; a use switched off is switch_off naming the account; an ai-accounts that cannot answer keep-away is kept away, fail closed, with KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE's row (ai-accounts R34)

R19 the sign-in arm (N796, Bob K2425; credentials R32; ai-accounts R7, R14, R19): an author served by their own held Claude sign-in with its standing use off is held back {switch_off, member}, never no_account or kept_away, no grant, no model; with it on, the grant is minted for the sign-in and the AI half runs as for the author's reference, its limits read as for any account

R20 standingAnswersFor answers a member's own new-find runs, once each, in run order after `after`, at most 200, with a cursor, labelled machine work from the standing question; nothing of another member's

R26 a standing question runs for a member no account serves as for any member: set, run, seen and ended with no account; new finds reach them once as a list, answer null, no model called

R27 onStandingSet: one listener per module, refused through membership.listenerRefusal; told {question, due} once after a question is set (its next due day) or ended by its author (null); a throwing listener never undoes the act; the notice writes nothing
R15 the saved query is checked with retrieval's relations (its R72) and zone (its R69), so a question is checked and run on one boundary (N584); a member's own search form is taken as the assistant's
